notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for overturned skiffs, missing livestock, and six blue lights moving through Reedwater.
notices.teaser: The creature is blamed for every incident. One survivor says it pushed him toward shore.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for strange tracks, stolen fence iron, and something walking the rails before a storm.
notices.teaser: Three nights of thefts. No footprints in the mud. One witness insists the creature was trying to warn her.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for recovery of a stolen Emberglass from beneath Hearthford.
notices.teaser: The village lantern has gone dark. The thief claims he took it for a reason.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for a well that still gives water but has begun taking names.
notices.teaser: Someone removed the old name-stone. The next bad bucket comes at dusk.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for a starving village, one living owlbear egg, and two parents looking for it.
notices.teaser: Hunger made the first decision. The party has to make the next one.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for a missing surveyor and one living wardstone claimed by two communities.
notices.teaser: The orchard is protecting something. Oakhaven still needs the shard.

notices.headline: Wanted adventurers for a missing apprentice and a bell ringing under perfectly still water.
notices.teaser: The bell may be a haunting. It may also be a warning nobody answered.
